newsitem.title: USA: United Dental sees matching Q3 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: United Dental sees matching Q3 EPS view.

text.p: United Dental Care Inc said Wednesday it expects third quarter earnings to match analysts' projection of $0.26 a share, up from $0.19 a year ago.
"We will meet the analysts' expectation for this quarter," Chief Financial Officer Mark Paper said in an interview at a Robinson-Humphrey investor conference here.
United Dental is expected to report third quarter results on November 4.
The Dallas-based managed dental care concern expects to report full-year 1996 earnings at or slightly above the First Call consensus estimate of $0.99 a share, Pape said.
"We think we'll hit the consensus, maybe a little better than that," he said.
In 1995 United Dental earned $0.68 a share.
